customManagers.description: The vendored Gateway API bundle (forts#118). No manager reads a raw CRD file, so the pin ages with no signal; the marker in the kustomization.yaml header is the one place the version is written as text. Renovate moves the marker. It does not download standard-install.yaml — a person runs the curl in the header, in the same PR, and TestGatewayAPIBundlePin keeps the PR red until that happens.

packageRules.description: Stable Gateway API releases only: upstream also publishes monthly-* and -rc.* refs, and the fleet must take neither.
